jobs_results.title: Programador Angular / GO
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos un desarrollador Front-end Angular para unirse a nuestro equipo en crecimiento. Como desarrollador serás responsable de diseñar, desarrollar y mantener las aplicaciones web escalables utilizando el framework de angular. Trabajaras en estrecha colaboración con los desarrolladores de Back-end para la creación de las UX de nuestros productos.

Responsabilidades

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web frontend utilizando Angular

Escribir código limpio, mantenible y reutilizable

Implementar las mejores prácticas de desarrollo web

Colaborar con diseñadores para convertir sus diseños en interfaces de usuario funcionales

Trabajar con desarrolladores back-end para integrar interfaces de usuario con API y servicios

Realizar pruebas unitarias y de integración para garantizar la calidad del código

Depurar y solucionar problemas de aplicaciones web

Mantenerse actualizado sobre las últimas tecnologías y tendencias de desarrollo web

Contribuir a la documentación y los... recursos técnicos

Requisitos

Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo web front-end / Angular

Conocimiento profundo de GO, HTML, CSS y JavaScript

Experiencia con herramientas de desarrollo comunes como Git,

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración

Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y como parte de un equipo

Actitud positiva y orientada a los resultados

jobs_results.title: Senior Web Developer For Sihot Products
jobs_results.description:
SIHOT India Private Limited is an extension of GUBSE AG in India. Our head office is situated in the Federal State of Saarland in Germany. We have been in the market for over 35 years and have established our hotel management system SIHOT as one of the leading brands in the hotel technology sector. So far, over 3500 hotel chains, resorts, hostels, MICE and city hotels have placed their trust in us. Among them, there are some renowned brands such as Best Western, FTI GROUP or Motel One. We are international and proud of the fact that our team is represented by employees from 15 nations at locations in Germany, Spain, Australia, Portugal, England and Brazil with the latest addition of India.Do you enjoy the process of analysis, putting ideas to implementation and making improvements? jobs_results.description: JavaScript, CSS, HTML, PHP, Informatik, WordPress, SCSS, Webentwicklung Web Developer (m/f/d) with focus on WordPress Start your future with us! Agentur dreimaleins is a full-service advertising agency in Baden-Baden for contemporary and modern marketing - both digital and classic. We specialize in the right marketing mix for small and medium-sized companies. We deliver the right solutions to achieve quick and long-term success. Web developer (m/f/d) with a focus on WordPress Workload Full-time Start employment immediately Industry / trade marketing Place of work Rheinstraße 111, Baden-Baden, Baden-Württemberg, 76532, Germany But now to you: Do you live and love web programming? Are you passionate about working with WordPress? Do you enjoy learning new technologies? Do you like to contribute constructively to an open and dynamic team? Then you should apply for a job with us! We are looking for a web developer / web designer for the implementation of websites with WordPress. We don't... care what you've done before. We rely on passion and common sense. Training or a degree may have preceded this, but is not a must. You're always in the right place with us! Responsibilities / main tasks You design and develop websites using WordPress You support our customers in securing their websites, plugin checks and take care of data protection You take care of the daily support of our customers - focus is on slightly trickier tasks You work independently on new topics and tasks and learn the necessary skills for this Qualifications / requirements You have a sound knowledge of WordPress HTML5, CSS3/SCSS (possibly JavaScript& PHP) are not foreign to you Creative customization of existing templates is child's play for you You have a good eye for layout and design You are motivated, show initiative and work in a structured manner You may have an apprenticeship or a university degree in computer science, digital communication or a comparable qualification Benefits of the employment A 35-hour working week 30 days vacation (with a 5-day week) and your birthday off! Extensive induction training Exciting collaboration in a small, constantly growing team Varied challenges and scope for your own ideas Fast decision-making processes, direct communication and an honest feedback culture Flexible working hours and some remote work Regular employee events and joint leisure activities Great colleagues and working in a family atmosphere Coffee, water, fruit and sweets are free of charge ... as well as many other benefits that are individually tailored to you Contact us Are you interested in this new challenge and would like to contribute your ideas and experience to our agency? Then we should get to know each other. Send us your application and/or an application video to ******. Your application will be sent to Susanne. She looks after our personnel. As assistant to the management, she is our Feel Good Manager. So feel good and free - and apply at ******. dreimaleins Marketing GmbH Rheinstraße 111 | 76532 Baden-Baden ****** | www.dreimaleins.com
